title: Dual monostable multivibrator (pin compatible with 74123)

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book 2nd ed. 1976, SN54221/SN74221 (section 6, Oct 1976)

pins.name: 1A
pins.text: negative-transition trigger input (fires on a falling edge while B is high)

pins.name: 1B
pins.text: positive-transition Schmitt-trigger input (fires on a rising edge while A is low)

pins.name: 1CLR'
pins.text: overriding clear: low ends the pulse, Q low; a rising edge with A low and B high also fires

pins.name: 1Rext/Cext
pins.text: timing resistor to VCC and capacitor terminal

pins.name: 2A
pins.text: negative-transition trigger input (fires on a falling edge while B is high)

pins.name: 2B
pins.text: positive-transition Schmitt-trigger input (fires on a rising edge while A is low)

pins.name: 2CLR'
pins.text: overriding clear: low ends the pulse, Q low; a rising edge with A low and B high also fires

pins.name: 2Rext/Cext
pins.text: timing resistor to VCC and capacitor terminal

functions.formula: Q = pulse state (high for tw after a trigger)
functions.text: Q goes high for tw = Cext * Rext * ln2 (about 0.7 Cext Rext) after a trigger; not retriggerable; once fired it ignores A and B.

state.changesOn: trigger edge on A or B, or rising edge of CLR'
rules: CLR' low: Q = L, Q' = H at once, regardless of A and B
A high or B low (steady): no trigger, Q = L
CLR' high, A low, B rising: one output pulse
CLR' high, A falling, B high: one output pulse
CLR' rising, A low, B high: one output pulse
Pulse width tw(out) = Cext Rext ln2 ~ 0.7 Cext Rext; once fired the output no longer depends on A and B; not retriggerable
Cext = 0, Rext = 2 kohm gives typically 30 ns

electrical.notes: SN74221: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. B input Schmitt: VT+ typ 1.55 V max 2 V, VT- min 0.8 typ 1.35 V; A input VT+ typ 1.4 max 2, VT- min 0.8 typ 1.4 V. Input edge rate: B min 1 V/s, A min 1 V/us. Rext 1.4-40 kohm, Cext 0-1000 uF. Duty cycle max 67% at Rext 2 kohm, 90% at max Rext. IIL A -1.6 mA, B and clear -3.2 mA.

notes: Pin-compatible with the 74123 except that it does not retrigger.
